tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_1.csv')
df['ChargePeriodStart'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart'])

# Compute z-score within each (account, service) group
df = df.sort_values(['SubAccountName','ServiceName','ChargePeriodStart'])
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
df['mean'] = g.transform('mean')
df['std'] = g.transform('std')
df['z'] = (df['BilledCost'] - df['mean']) / df['std']

top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(15)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','mean','std','z']])
